name: 感知哈希分析
description: 使用 perceptual hashing algorithms 以检测 near-duplicate images and identify localized 篡改s.
algorithm: Multi-Scale Perceptual Hashing with DCT and Gradient Features
mechanism: Computes compact perceptual hash fingerprints (pHash, dHash) that capture the essential visual structure of an image. Comparing hash distances 之间 image regions reveals localized edits.
parameters: Hash types: pHash (DCT-based), dHash (梯度), aHash (average), Hash size: 64-bit, Block: 8×8
source: Zauner, C. (2010) — Implementation and Benchmarking of Perceptual Image Hash Functions, Master Thesis, TU Graz
useCase: Near-duplicate 检测 and localized 篡改 identification through hash comparison

references.title: Zauner, C. (2010) — Implementation and Benchmarking of Perceptual Image Hash Functions, Master Thesis, TU Graz

strengths:
• 计算非常快速
• 对旋转和缩放具有容忍度
• 紧凑的表示
• 适合批量比较
limitations:
• Limited 灵敏度 to subtle changes
• Cannot localize specific 篡改s
• Hash collisions possible
• Not suitable for fine-grained 分析
